keywordsGuide.title: How do I pick good keywords?

english.title: Write them in English
english.body: Articles are tagged with English terms, even the ones written in other languages. Keep your keywords in English. Proper names, like "iron maiden", work either way.

quantity.title: Use plenty of keywords
quantity.body: The more keywords, the more ground your feed covers. With too few it stays empty. You can use {{min}} to {{max}}.

notAlone.title: One keyword isn't enough
notAlone.body: An article only joins the feed if it matches more than one keyword. Add the terms that usually show up together: with "iron maiden", also include "metal", "rock" and "heavy metal".

mix.title: Mix specific and generic
mix.body: "iron maiden" only brings what mentions the band; "rock" brings a lot. Together they keep the feed between empty and flooded.

fromNow.title: It counts from now on
fromNow.body: The feed fills up as new articles arrive. Creating or changing keywords doesn't bring old articles back.
